cycle.source: the vol-arb rules' NVDA continuation, computed 2026-11-17: decided on the entry night and never recomputed; only the legs are marked each night

sides.put_rich: sell the put, buy the call
sides.call_rich: buy the put, sell the call

fills.mid: the legs at their mids at entry, the hedge at each open with no cost
fills.stress: the leg sold at the bid and the leg bought at the ask at entry, and 5 bp of each hedge trade's value

vol.how: realized: zero-mean, annualized (x 252 / returns) over NVDA's daily log returns from the entry close to the mark; implied: the measured at-the-money vol of the cycle's chain at entry

notes: November 12's open of $151.005 is genuine: LSEG's daily bar for that session has a low of $148.80, a high of $167.14 and a close of $166.19 on 747.7M shares, the day NVIDIA announced Jensen Huang's resignation (Colette Kress is interim CEO). The hedge was rebalanced at that open, as the backtest rebalances at each open.

NVIDIA's November 17 report falls inside this cycle, so by the backtest's rule (actual report dates) the earnings flag f7 is 1. The data the entry decision was first computed from held past report dates only (f7 = 0), so the models' choices are shown under both readings.
NVIDIA's fiscal Q3 2027 results came on November 17 after the close: the November 18 mark was the first after them.

November 16's closing mid for the put ($45.975) is under its intrinsic value ($46.36), so it has no implied vol; its IV is carried from November 13 (the registered rule) and its delta recomputed from it at that close.
The call had no two-sided closing quote on November 18 and November 19, so its mark and IV there are carried from November 17 (the registered rule).
